title: 第21章 大黄的恐惧第22章 进山寻药前的准备
content_zh:
;;
李向东回到村里，故意迈着“嘴炮”那种六亲不认的步伐。
背着手转了一个大圈才往家里走。
众多关系好的乡亲瞧着李向东上午被警察带走，下午就安然无恙的回来。
心中不由得感慨本事真大。
其中看着李向东长大的吴奶奶更是激动到拿出手帕抹眼泪。
“向东娃子，回来了。”
“嗯，吴奶奶，您吃过饭了吧？”
“吃过了，中午吃得你送的鱼，味道很鲜美，回来就好啊......”
李向东逛到王彩凤家门口附近的时候。
她正惬意的嗑着瓜子，和左邻右舍绘声绘色分享她挨了一顿操心换来的“机密”消息。
“我跟你们讲，他进了那里面，先是一顿毒打免不了，然后是辣椒水抽脸。”
“再不老实交待又是一顿爆炒辣子伺候。”
“等到他出来，你们看着吧，绝对没个人形，不在床上躺个三五个月都下不得地。”
王彩凤说得唾沫横飞，忽然发觉邻居们眼神飘来飘去。
“你们别不信啊，但凡我有哪一点说得不对，到时候你们来找我。”
李向东听她说的比真的还真，凑到她身后猛地一拍她肩膀。
“找你做什么？”
“啊！”
“有鬼啊！”

王彩凤扭头见到口中正在遭受毒打的人忽然出现在身后。
吓得尖叫出声。
整个人一下没坐稳从椅子上跌坐下去，结结实实摔一屁股墩。
“哎呦，你个害人精，怎么这么快就放出来了？”
王彩凤扶着椅子站起来，张口就骂。
李向东呵呵一笑：“要进去也是你的两个老公进去，还轮不到我。”
“扑哧。”
看戏邻居听到这样别致的称呼，都知道所指的是谁，一时间来不及掩嘴全都笑出声。
王彩凤俏脸一红，双手叉腰拿出泼辣劲反驳：
“你再这样胡说八道，信不信老娘撕烂你的嘴！”
“呵呵。”
李向东怼起人来嘴也狠毒：“我只有一张嘴，还要留着吃饭。”
“你上下两张嘴都吃人，我说不过你。”
说罢拍拍屁股走人。

Li Xiangdong returned to the village, deliberately taking the step of "talking loudly" and not recognizing his relatives.
He walked in a big circle with his hands behind his back before walking home.
Many close villagers watched as Li Xiangdong was taken away by the police in the morning and returned safe and sound in the afternoon.
I couldn't help but feel that I was really capable.
Among them, Grandma Wu, who watched Li Xiangdong grow up, was so excited that she took out a handkerchief to wipe her tears.
"Xiangdong Wazi, you're back."
"Well, Grandma Wu, have you had your meal?"
"I've eaten. I had the fish you gave me for lunch. It tasted delicious. It'll be nice to come back..."
When Li Xiangdong wandered near the door of Wang Caifeng's house.
She was happily eating melon seeds, and vividly shared with her neighbors the "secret" information that she had gained through a lot of worry.
"Let me tell you, when he entered there, he was beaten severely and then slapped in the face with pepper water."
"If you don't tell me the truth, you'll be served another hot and spicy meal."
"When he comes out, just watch. He will definitely have no human form. He won't be able to get off the ground unless he lies in bed for three to five months."
Wang Caifeng was so speechless that she suddenly noticed that the neighbors' eyes were wandering.
"Don't believe me. If anything I say is wrong, you can come to me when the time comes."
Li Xiangdong heard that what she said was more serious than the truth. He came up behind her and slapped her on the shoulder.
"What are you looking for?"
"Ah!"
"There's a ghost!"
Wang Caifeng turned around and saw the person who was being beaten suddenly appeared behind her.
He screamed in fear.
He couldn't sit still and fell down from the chair, falling hard on his butt.
"Oh, you harmful person, why were you released so quickly?"
Wang Caifeng stood up holding the chair and started to curse.
Li Xiangdong chuckled: "It's your two husbands who want to go in. It's not my turn yet."
"Puch."
When the neighbors at the theater heard such a unique address, they all knew who it was referring to, and they all laughed out loud without having time to cover their mouths.
Wang Caifeng blushed, put her hands on her hips and retorted fiercely:
"If you keep talking nonsense like this, believe it or not, I will tear your mouth apart!"
"Haha."
Li Xiangdong is also vicious when he criticizes people: "I only have one mouth, and I have to keep it to eat."
"You eat people with both mouths, I can't blame you."
Then he patted his butt and left.
